What's new in Tareekh 2.4

AI for whole cases and for finding cases, at the lowest AI cost

Tareekh 2.4 brings AI to whole cases and to finding cases, at the lowest possible AI cost: every order is read on the phone (straight from the PDF; OCR only for scanned pages), kept as text, and indexed on the phone, so only the passages that matter are sent to the AI service you connected. The pictures use made-up example cases.

  • Date-wise, from all saved orders
  • English, বাংলা or हिन्दी
  • Cost shown before it runs
  • Each order summarised once; updates cost only new orders

Ask about this case

  • Questions about the whole case
  • Only matching passages are sent
  • Found on the phone by words and by meaning
  • Every point names its order date

  • Checks your saved cases first

Lower AI cost everywhere

  • Orders read straight from the PDF (no OCR when typed)
  • Text only, no page pictures
  • Repeated headers and signatures removed
  • Optional economy model for summaries
How the cost is kept low. A typed order is read from the PDF itself; OCR runs only on pages that have no text. The text is cleaned and split into short passages, kept on the phone with a keyword index and meaning vectors made on the phone. A question sends only the 5 to 8 passages that match it; a synopsis summarises each order once and builds on those summaries. The AI services can only read words, so the passages themselves are sent, never the whole set of orders.

How to use it

  1. Connect an AI service in Settings (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Qwen or Kimi) with your API key.
  2. Open a case: Synopsis or Ask about this case. Check the cost, then tap Write.
  3. Search tab: Ask AI to find a case, in your words or with a summons attached.
  4. Cases tab: Ask AI about my cases. Cause lists tab: type the list you want.
